real_defects.issue: formatMoney and journal divided every amount by 100, but Stripe sends zero-decimal currencies (JPY, KRW, VND...) in whole units: a 12,000 yen invoice showed as ¥120 on the dashboard and journaled as 120.00. Fixed with minorExponent (0/2/3 by Stripe's list), journal takes currency, server passes the synced currency.
scheduleTable printed '+' and '-' before the formatted amount, so a credit-only month read '+-$79' billed and '--$79' recognised. Fixed with one sign per cell.

the self-hosted dashboard still said 'Credit notes reduce revenue in the month they are issued', but linkCredits (2026-11-17) spreads a linked credit over the credited line's remaining period. Reworded to match the code and the FAQ.

same divide-by-100 for zero-decimal currencies in formatMoney, monthsCsv and the CSV import (README listed it as a known gap). Fixed with minorExponent; cancel-flow/admin.mjs money() had drifted from flow.mjs's zero-decimal list and is fixed too. Guard: platform/ci/test_stripe_zero_decimal.py.
